hero_subhead_prefix: Helping founders develop the leadership and organizational infrastructure required to build enterprises capable of growth, scale, sustainability, and
distinct_body: The Founders Organization has its own journey, separate from The .LLab. It exists because founders face a specific problem: significant talent and momentum, without the leadership infrastructure required to make it durable.
phases_eyebrow: The Four Phases of Leadership Infrastructure™

phases.title: Foundations
phases.description: Understanding the founder — purpose, potential, values, identity — before touching the org chart.

phases.title: Infrastructure Planning & Management
phases.description: Determining what infrastructure the enterprise actually needs, and how the pieces connect.

phases.title: Internal Operating Systems
phases.description: Structures, decision pathways, and accountability that outlast any one hire.

phases.title: Preservation
phases.description: An organization that can grow, transfer, and run — beyond the founder, into legacy.

apply_headline: Ready to build the infrastructure behind your enterprise?
apply_body: The Founders Organization is a distinct offering for founders building enterprises with the leadership and organizational infrastructure required for growth, scale, sustainability, and legacy.

tiers.description: An entry point into the Founders Organization for the people closest to a Founder — access to the four-phase infrastructure model and founder community.
An expanded entry point into the Founders Organization for friends and family who want to participate more deeply in the founding journey.
Founding participation in the Founders Organization, including the four-phase infrastructure model, founder community, and introductory cohort resources.
Founding participation at the highest contribution level, supporting the development and preservation of leadership infrastructure for founders building toward lasting legacy.

founder_benefits: Every founding option includes a permanent Founder Number, a digital Founder Card, and 20% off eligible future Co.LLab™ products while signed in.
recognition_body: Founder participation supports The Co.LLab™'s Omnidirectional Enterprise™ model — where value, authority, intelligence, IP, and opportunity move in multiple directions, not purely top-down. Founders help strengthen Leadership Infrastructure™ and the ecosystem connecting creators, businesses, nonprofits, organizations, and enterprise — turning human potential into performance, sustainable enterprise value, and lasting legacy.
recognition_empty: Founder Numbers are issued the moment a Founder purchase completes — check back soon.
